region.coverage_note: Early bid screening: inventory footprints are displayed, but setbacks, wetland ratings, shoreline jurisdiction, agricultural restrictions and protective buffers are not confirmed. Gray map areas are unresolved, not a verified buildable envelope. No permit history is loaded. Utility, school and fire districts, credits and additional reviews require confirmation.
region.critical_area_note: PCC Title 18E regulates wetlands, habitat, flood, volcanic, landslide and other critical areas. The County says actual site conditions determine requirements even when maps show none. The 2025 critical-area update and subsequent Category IV wetland clarification must be checked against current applicable rules. No fixed buffer is inferred from an unrated inventory.
region.search_distance_note: Map query distances are screening extents, not regulatory buffer widths.

wa-pierce-gis.jurisdiction: Pierce County GIS parcel and screening layers
wa-pierce-gis.citation: Pierce County GIS parcel and screening layers
wa-pierce-gis.excerpt: County ArcGIS catalogue supplies parcel polygons and situs addresses, incorporated city boundaries, wetlands, streams, landslide and volcanic hazards, electrical service providers, military bases and shoreline designations. Only allowlisted non-person fields are requested; inventories are not field determinations.

wa-pierce-critical-code.jurisdiction: Pierce County Title 18E and wetland-buffer clarification
wa-pierce-critical-code.citation: Pierce County Title 18E and wetland-buffer clarification
wa-pierce-critical-code.excerpt: County identifies adopted critical-area amendments effective February 1, 2025 and clarifies Category IV wetland buffers as 50 feet for all habitat scores under 18E.30.060. This is not applied to unrated inventory polygons. Verify full applicable standards and site conditions.

wa-pierce-electrical-source.excerpt: Tacoma Power serves Tacoma, Fircrest, University Place and Fife, plus parts of Lakewood, Steilacoom, JBLM and unincorporated Pierce. Use service territory and L&I inspection-authority guidance, not mailing-city alone.

wa-pierce-military.excerpt: County GIS maps military installation boundaries independently of incorporated cities. Intersection triggers confirmation of installation land status and responsible federal authority; it does not establish local permit authority.

wa-pierce-water.excerpt: Water adequacy and well siting are separately reviewed by the health authority. Confirm provider capacity, legal availability and Ecology requirements for the specific basin.
